open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: Retro Handheld Gaming & FPGA Customization
proposals.buyer_persona: Collectors and modders of retro handhelds (Anbernic, Miyoo, Odin) and MiSTer FPGA setups who want to customize their devices and display them proudly.
product_angles: 3D printable display stands and custom ergonomic grips (Cults3D)
Pre-scaled vinyl decal cut files / skins (SVG Pack)
Console-inspired aesthetic wallpapers and custom OS theme assets (Digital Download)
proposals.first_test_product: Parametric 3D-printable wall mount and desk stand for Miyoo Mini Plus / Anbernic RG35XX

proposals.name: Quail Keepers & Micro-Homesteaders
proposals.buyer_persona: Suburban or urban homesteaders raising Coturnix quails for eggs and meat, looking for specialized tools and community identity because standard chicken gear is too large.
product_angles: Quail-specific egg carton labels and cottage industry branding templates (SVG Pack)
Daily quail flock health & egg production logbooks (KDP)
3D-printed quail-sized gravity feeders and egg-spiral dispensers (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: The Essential Coturnix Quail Flock Record Keeping Logbook (KDP)

proposals.name: Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA)
proposals.buyer_persona: HEMA sword fighters, historical fencing enthusiasts, and medieval combat practitioners who train weekly and obsess over historical manuals (Lichtenauer, Fiore).
product_angles: Fencing bout analysis journals and training logs (KDP)
Cleaned-up vector designs of historical fechtbuch combat stances (SVG / Redbubble)
3D printable wall-mounts for feder swords and gear drying racks (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: HEMA Fighter's Training Journal & Bout Analyzer (KDP)

proposals.name: Solo Journaling RPG Players
proposals.buyer_persona: Tabletop RPG fans who play solo journaling games (like Thousand Year Old Vampire, Ironsworn, Colostle) requiring heavy writing, mapping, and prompt-tracking.
product_angles: Themed, highly structured prompt journals with atmospheric borders (KDP)
Printable oracle decks and encounter generator cards (TGC / PDF)
Modular dungeon-mapping hex tiles for print-and-play (SVG / PDF)
proposals.first_test_product: Dark Fantasy Solo RPG Journal & Campaign Mapper (KDP)

proposals.name: Amateur Radio (Ham Radio) Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Licensed radio amateurs (DXers) who log global contacts, build antennas, and exchange physical QSL confirmation cards.
product_angles: ITU Zone & Prefix reference logs and contact record books (KDP)
Printable vintage-style QSL card design templates (SVG / Canva Links)
3D-printed portable dipole antenna wire-winders and coax-guides (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: Amateur Radio DX Contact Logbook with ITU Prefix Map (KDP)

proposals.name: French Local Volunteer Fire Stations (Sapeurs-Pompiers)
proposals.buyer_persona: Local French fire stations ('casernes de sapeurs-pompiers') organizing annual 'Sainte-Barbe' celebrations, retirement gifts, or public open houses.
product_angles: Customizable emblem templates for specific regional fire-stations (SVG Pack)
Station shift planner and guard duty notebooks (KDP)
3D printable personalized locker gear tags or helmet displays (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: Carnet de Garde du Sapeur-Pompier - Agenda de Postes et d'Interventions (KDP)
